purpose: Long-running, serverless Node.js HTTP functions deployed onto your Neon branch, with DATABASE_URL injected automatically and compute that runs next to your data. Use when a user wants to host an API,
use_when: Create and deploy Neon serverless functions (JavaScript/TypeScript)
Webhook handlers, event processing, scheduled jobs on Neon
Edge-adjacent compute directly in Neon without external Functions
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Neon serverless functions (webhooks, jobs, edge compute) -> this. General Postgres -> neon-postgres. Branching -> neon-postgres-branches. AI Gateway -> neon-ai-gateway. Supabase Edge Functions -> supabase.
